issue_context.title: prepare stmt with stale read get wrong result
comments:
em...
Is it because the `stale_read_ts` is not set properly?

> Is it because the `stale_read_ts` is not set properly?

Yes, the prepare/execute stmt only set `stale_read_ts` when preparing.

review_comments: What's the difference between `OnExecutePreparedStmt` and `OnSelectTable`, why do we need to calculate the `TS` in two places? Is it possible to merge them into one?

Here we set the ts evaluator which needs to be calculated to staleness processor when preparing, and it'll be returned and set to plan cache.

When invoking `OnExecutePreparedStmt`, it only uses the ts evaluator from plan cache, so it's not necessary to set a evaluator that requires calculation to get a timestamp.
We could add some comments about the above logic.
